From Old Norse hrosshvalr and Dutch walrus.

parole.significato: a roof frame or roof-bearing construction with a ridge; roof framework.
parole.testo: From Old Norse raust (“roof frame, roof-bearing construction, gable”), probably borrowed from or influenced by Dutch rust (“rest, support”). Compare Icelandic raust (“gable; gable wall”).

parole.significato: to put a roof frame on; to raise or construct the roof framework of a building.
parole.testo: From røst (“roof frame, roof-bearing construction, gable”) + -e (“verb-forming suffix”), from the noun røst (“roof frame, gable”), from Old Norse raust (“roof frame, roof-bearing construction, gable”), probably from or influenced by Dutch rust (“rest, support”).
